needs.family: Dry Puppy/Kibble (growth formula)
needs.description: Complete puppy growth dry kibble formulated for a 5-month-old, high-energy dog — appropriate kibble size for short-snouted (brachycephalic) mouths, balanced calories for growth but with attention to portion control (choose puppy/young-dog formula). Offer a Mars-brand puppy formula option given user brand bias; ensure label does NOT list duck or duck meal. Recommend feeding cup and package sizes that match moderate budget and daily feeding needs.
needs.rationale: At 5 months AJ requires daily, age-appropriate balanced puppy food to support rapid growth and high activity. Pugs are brachycephalic with fast eating tendencies — choose a kibble shaped for easier gripping and portion control. Must avoid duck due to allergy.

needs.family: Soft High-Value Training Treats (small, single-protein, non-duck)
needs.description: Small, soft training treats (pea- to fingertip-sized) that are low-calorie and highly palatable for fast reinforcement during training and socialization. Choose chicken- or beef-based single-protein treats or hypoallergenic novel-protein formulations that explicitly exclude duck.
needs.rationale: AJ is energetic and at a sensitive learning age (5 months); frequent reinforcement is required for successful training. Treats are used daily in short sessions — single-ingredient, small-format treats reduce calorie burden and avoid triggering AJ's duck allergy.

needs.family: Padded No-Pull/Front-Clip Harness (brachycephalic-friendly)
needs.description: Sized, padded front-clip no-pull harness designed to distribute pressure across the chest (not the neck). Look for breathable mesh, quick-release buckles, adjustable straps to fit a growing 5-month-old pug; pick size based on current girth/weight and adjustable range. Avoid neck collars for walks to reduce tracheal/airway pressure.
needs.rationale: Pugs have sensitive tracheas and are prone to respiratory stress; a front-clip, padded harness minimizes neck pressure and is a safety necessity for every walk. This is an immediate safety item if AJ is walked outdoors (and needed during hunting/leaf-blower season for secure control).

needs.family: Cooling Mat/Non-Electric Cooling Pad
needs.description: Self-cooling gel or phase-change mat sized for a small/medium dog that provides immediate passive cooling indoors. Non-electric, reusable, durable cover that is chew-resistant if possible. Place in cool shaded indoor area and in crate/nap spots.
needs.rationale: Local excessive heat warnings and AJ's brachycephalic anatomy create immediate heat-stress risk. A cooling mat reduces core temperature risk during heat waves and is a safety item that should not be delayed.

needs.family: Elevated Stainless Steel Water Bowl or Pet Water Fountain
needs.description: Constant-access water solution: either a raised stainless steel bowl sized for a growing pup or a circulating pet water fountain to encourage drinking and keep water cooler/clean. Stainless steel preferred for hygiene; size appropriate for a 5-month-old with daily consumption in warm weather.
needs.rationale: Hydration is a daily consumable and essential right now during excessive heat. Pugs overheat easily; constant access to clean, cool water is critical to prevent heat-related illness.

needs.family: Durable Chew Toy for Strong Chewers (rubber/tough treat-dispensing)
needs.description: Single heavy-duty chew toy made from tough natural rubber or composite rated for strong chewers that can be stuffed with kibble/treats (treat-dispensing) and withstand vigorous chewing. Size appropriate for AJ's mouth; avoid toys with small parts that can be ingested.
needs.rationale: AJ is described as a very strong chewer; without durable chew outlets he may destroy household items and risk intestinal obstruction. A heavy-duty chew toy provides safe, daily chewing outlet and can help with teething at 5 months.
evidence: pet_characteristic: about: AJ is very energetic and very strong

needs.family: Slow-Feeder Bowl / Puzzle Feeder (single-compartment)
needs.description: Slow-feeder bowl or low-difficulty puzzle feeder designed to reduce gulping and extend meal time; dishwasher-safe and sized for puppy portions. Look for shallow, rounded sections appropriate for short-faced dogs.
needs.rationale: Pugs can gulp food and are prone to obesity and regurgitation; a slow feeder reduces bloat/gulp risk and promotes digestion. Not urgent but recommended now as part of preventive care.

needs.family: Teething Chews (soft-to-medium rubber/composite)
needs.description: Chews designed for teething puppies that are softer than heavy-duty chews — pliable rubber or textured composite to soothe gums but still durable. Should be non-toxic, dishwasher-safe, and appropriately sized.
needs.rationale: At 5 months AJ is in active teething stage. Teething chews support dental comfort, reduce destructive chewing, and complement the more durable chew chosen under essentials.

needs.family: De-shedding Brush / Undercoat Rake
needs.description: Brush designed to remove loose undercoat hair (rubber brush or stainless blade de-shedder) suitable for short-haired breeds like pugs. Easy-grip handle, washable, sized for regular weekly use.
needs.rationale: Calendar shows fall shedding season and allergy season — pugs shed heavily. Regular deshedding reduces loose hair in the apartment and air particulate load (helpful for family/allergy control).

needs.family: Facial Fold Cleansing Wipes / Fold Care Kit
needs.description: Gentle, pH-balanced wipes or a small fold-cleaning kit for cleaning facial folds and skin wrinkles; fragrance-free, hypoallergenic formula. Include small soft cloths and an air-drying recommendation.
needs.rationale: Pugs develop debris and moisture in facial folds, which can cause irritation or infection. Regular fold cleaning is an age-appropriate preventive care routine to avoid skin issues.

needs.family: Paw Balm & Paw Cleaning Wipes
needs.description: Pet-safe paw balm to moisturize pads and cleaning wipes to remove road/debris after walks; useful for rainy PNW conditions. Choose non-toxic formula and small travel pack.
needs.rationale: Rain season and outdoor walks can cause dry/cracked pads and dirty paws; paw care prevents discomfort and secondary infections especially for apartment living where outdoor walks are frequent.

needs.family: Clicker & Treat Pouch
needs.description: Small handheld clicker and a hands-free treat pouch that clips to a belt for efficient reward-based training sessions. Pouch should be durable, washable, and sized for the chosen training treats.
needs.rationale: AJ is at a prime socialization/training age. Clicker + treat pouch improve training efficiency and help manage high energy through structured sessions.

needs.family: Nail Trimmer or Pet Nail Grinder
needs.description: Pet nail clippers or an electric grinder sized for small/medium dogs; look for safety guard and quiet motor (grinder) to reduce stress. Include a file for smoothing edges.
needs.rationale: Regular nail maintenance is an at-home preventive care need for apartment-dwelling dogs; shorter nails improve gait and comfort. Not immediately urgent but important to start early.

needs.family: LED Clip / High-Visibility Reflective Gear
needs.description: Small LED clip or reflective vest/strip for evening or low-light walks, easy to attach to harness or collar. Rechargeable or battery-operated options, water-resistant.
needs.rationale: Calendar triggers include hunting season and leaf blower/noise seasons (early morning/late evening outings may be needed). Visibility improves safety during low-light times and protects AJ during outdoor excursions.

needs.family: Washable Crate Pad or Portable Nap Mat
needs.description: Machine-washable, low-profile crate pad or travel nap mat sized for a small/medium dog; quick-dry material and non-skid backing. Good for crate, apartment sofa, or car travel.
needs.rationale: Provides a consistent comfort spot for rest and can be used for crate training. Useful to establish resting routine and reduce stress during schedule changes (school year adjustments).

needs.family: Short Training Leash & Long Line (15–30 ft) Combo
needs.description: Two-leash approach: a short, sturdy leash for city/apartment control and a 15–30 ft long line for recall training in the yard. Durable webbing and secure hardware compatible with the no-pull harness.
needs.rationale: AJ is energetic — controlled outdoor exercise plus recall training in a large yard is ideal. Long line supports safe off-leash recall practice; short leash provides apartment-safe control.

needs.family: Interactive Treat-Dispensing Puzzle Toy (rotational challenge)
needs.description: Stable, moderately challenging treat-dispensing puzzle toy sized for a puppy that encourages problem-solving; dishwasher-safe pieces and rubberized textures for durability. Use kibble or small treats.
needs.rationale: Mental stimulation reduces destructive behavior in high-energy dogs and provides indoor enrichment during rain season or heat. Rotating challenges keeps AJ engaged without introducing allergenic ingredients (use non-duck treats).

needs.family: Snuffle Mat (foraging scent enrichment)
needs.description: Fabric snuffle mat for scattering kibble/treats to encourage foraging and slow feeding. Machine-washable, non-toxic fabric strips and base with weighted non-slip backing.
needs.rationale: Snuffle mats provide mental enrichment and slow the eating process while keeping AJ engaged indoors during inclement weather or during busy household schedules.

needs.family: Flirt Pole (interactive chase toy)
needs.description: Durable flirt pole with replaceable safety-stitched lure for high-energy short-burst exercise sessions. Lightweight handle, replaceable tether, sized to avoid swallowing small pieces.
needs.rationale: Provides high-intensity exercise in short sessions — ideal for a high-energy 5-month-old in an apartment when outdoor exercise may be limited by weather or schedule.

needs.family: Durable Indoor Fetch Ball / Soft Bounce Ball
needs.description: Soft, non-marking, durable ball sized for short-faced mouths and indoor play; bouncy but gentle on floors and teeth. Replaceable and easy to clean.
needs.rationale: Helps expend energy indoors in a way gentle on apartment surfaces and AJ's mouth; complements outdoor yard play.

needs.family: Hide-and-Seek Plush Treat Toys (multiple small pockets)
needs.description: Set of plush toys with hidden pockets for kibble or small treats; washable and sized for puppy use. Use as low-effort mental games and travel distractions.
needs.rationale: Low-intensity mental enrichment that keeps AJ occupied and encourages scent work and problem-solving without heavy physical exertion on hot days.

needs.family: Portable Travel Water Bottle with Attached Bowl
needs.description: Leak-proof travel water bottle with fold-out bowl or attached cup for on-the-go hydration during yard play and walks; easy to carry and clean.
needs.rationale: Useful for outings to the yard or short hikes and is especially helpful during heat warnings to maintain hydration away from home.

needs.family: Cozy Washable Blanket (small size)
needs.description: Soft, machine-washable cuddle blanket sized for a small/medium dog; breathable fabric so it can be used year-round without overheating. Useful in crate or on the couch.
needs.rationale: Provides comfort and a familiar scent anchor, helpful for calming during noisy seasonal events (leaf blowers/hunting), and for routine changes tied to school scheduling.

needs.family: Rotating Toy Set / Toy Storage Bin
needs.description: A small organization bin for rotating toys (keeps a subset accessible while storing others) or a small rotating 3–5 toy set to preserve novelty. Durable, easy-to-clean storage.
needs.rationale: Toy rotation extends interest in toys and reduces boredom; storage keeps apartment tidy and protects toys from chewing when not supervised.

needs.family: Scent Work Starter Kit (novice-level scent games)
needs.description: Beginner scent enrichment kit or simple scent-target toys (non-toxic scent pads and containers) to teach search games; avoids chemical additives and uses food rewards (not duck).
needs.rationale: Scent games provide high mental stimulation with low physical strain — ideal for days when heat or rain limit outdoor exercise.

needs.family: Tug Toy (durable rope or rubber hybrid)
needs.description: Durable tug toy constructed from reinforced rope or rubber hybrid designed for strong chewers; loop handle for owner grip and replaceable head/tug section for safety.
needs.rationale: Provides owner-led interactive play that burns energy and strengthens training bonds; good for short bursts of exercise in the yard or indoors.

needs.family: Calming Blanket or Compression Wrap (anxiety vest)
needs.description: Lightweight calming wrap or pressure vest designed to apply gentle, even pressure to reduce noise/anxiety sensitivity; adjustable sizes for a 5-month pup; breathable fabric recommended for heat.
needs.rationale: Calendar includes noise/stress triggers (leaf blower, hunting season). A pressure wrap can help AJ remain calmer during noisy events; use alongside behavior strategies.
